The mods will move the thread if they see it's needed so no worries there.   This seems related to the just the video game.  

Handelabra, who makes the video game, plans to make all variants of the hero and villains available and if some hero doesn't have any it's more just a matter of time.  As to help with unlocking DW Setback it still ends up being a bit of luck but the strategy I found success with on normal or advanced was looking for Setback to start with Friendly Fire and DW Mr Fixer after Setback with Dual Crowbars in hand.  With those Mr Fixer can take out the Operative round one and that immensely helps.

posts.name: The Burning Stickman
posts.cooked:
Yeah, that one involves a lot of luck. If you're really lucky, you can Risk into having both Silver Lining and Friendly Fire out in turn one, which makes the combo sustainable and repeatable. The Amulet can also be a lifesaver -- since you don't have vanilla Nightmist's drawing, you'll want to use it sparingly, but if you can, say, get the Chairman to hit himself (and then counter himself) or get the Hired Gun to whack himself out of action, it saves you a lot of pain. Going into Mistform can also help, if you can get Nightmist in a place where she's drawing the most heat (highest HP is most likely).

But yeah. It needs a lot of luck no matter how you go about it.

just thought i'd let yalls know.
